input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: a browser sweep for visible floating-point noise on venture pages, and fixes for what it found
errors: first draft of check_float_noise.mjs used a file:// string entry guard; check_cli_entry.py (via unwired_checks.py) caught it and it was fixed before merge

doc_friction.issue: its list of already-clean sweeps names static checks but not the dozen browser sweeps in platform/ci (check_page_runtime.js, check_blank_inputs.js, page_js_errors.mjs, ...); my first idea (a console-error sweep) already existed and cost a few minutes to find

notes: Idea: float-noise sweep (platform/ci/check_float_noise.mjs + test_check_float_noise.mjs). Loads 3,862 venture HTML pages offline, reads text on load, after input/change, after clicking calculate-like buttons, and after nudging number fields to awkward decimals. First full run (no nudge): 1 hit (grape-grower yield ladder 2.8000000000000003). With nudge: 3 more (etsy-profit break-even 11.999999999999998 listings; wedding-florist 14.100000000000001 crew-hours; pension grid 3.0999999999999996%). A source grep for the grape-grower pattern (rounded label then ...row(o, ov) spread overwrites it) found the same bug in junk-car-buyer's three ladders. All five fixed; four carry a regression test in calc.test.mjs (failure on old code checked for junk-car); the wedding-florist fix is an inline display formatter in index.html, verified by the sweep only. Etsy break-even is now a whole listing count (Math.ceil(x - 1e-9)), which changes the answer for fractional cases (12.5 -> 13). After fixes: 0 of 3,862, 175 s. Venture suites: run_venture_tests.py on the 5 slugs, 5 ok. unwired_checks.py: 150/165 pass, 15 skipped (pytest absent). Not wired into a workflow (control-plane edit); it is a .mjs, so unwired_checks.py does not pick it up either. Next if it pays off: a browser_checks-style registration so it runs on PRs touching ventures.
